messages:
Jessica: Quick sync — finalizing calibration prompt slices for the quant bakeoff (FP8/INT8/GPTQ/AWQ). Need a consensus on stratification + anchors. Thoughts?
Rahul: propose 3 strata by token-length: short(<32), mid(32-128), long(>128). sample 500 each per stratum per task. keeps latency and recency coverage.
Mike: 500 each seems heavy for AWQ runs; cost blowup. maybe 250 for long.
Elaine: Agree on lengths, also add source stratification: docs, code, convo, multi-step. ensure <=1% overlap with production logs to avoid leakage.
Rahul: +1 for source buckets. Suggest anchor set of 100 "gold" prompts per task (hand-reviewed) for decomp/edgecases.
Jessica: For anchors — should they be seeded from earlier regression failures and synthetic adversarial perturbations?
Mike: yes, anchors = regression+adversarial. Also include negative controls: nonsense prompts and truncated inputs to catch hallucination spikes.
calib-bot: Auto-stats: current prompt pool=12,400; unique tokens distribution: short 46%, mid 38%, long 16%. estimated AWQ runtime (250 per long)= ~18 GPU-hours.
Elaine: Sampling heuristic: stratified random w/ deterministic seed per experiment. e.g., `jq '.prompts | group_by(.source) | map(.[:N])'` or a simple python sampler:
```
import random
random.seed(20260320)
# stratified_sample(pool, strata, counts) -> csv
```
Jessica: OK action items: (1) Rahul to produce sampling script (seeded), (2) Mike to estimate cost for 250/500 variants, (3) Elaine to curate 100 anchors from regression failures. Aim to freeze calib set by EOD Thurs.
Rahul: I'll drop a PoC script and example split by EOD today. seed=20260320
Mike: I'll run cost sim and post numbers in #eng-ml.
Elaine: I'll start pulling anchors; need help rating severity — volunteers?
Jessica: I'll help with rating. tagging @mike @rahul. thanks :pray:
calib-bot: Thread archived to bakeoff-2026 channel draft.
